key_concepts: Acceleration is a change in speed, direction, or both
Uniformly accelerated motion involves constant acceleration
Uniform circular motion occurs when an object moves in a circle at constant speed
In circular motion, velocity direction is tangent to the circular path
Centripetal means moving or tending to move toward the center
Centrifugal means moving or tending to move away from the center
A centripetal force directed toward the center keeps an object in circular motion
An object in uniform circular motion accelerates because its direction changes
Centripetal acceleration is calculated as a = v^2 / r
Centripetal force is calculated as F = mv^2 / r
Increasing the radius of a circular path decreases centripetal acceleration for the same s
